e.title: TISS（巴西补充医疗数据交换标准）：强制性电子交换 + TUSS 术语表
e.title_en: TISS (Brazil’s supplementary-health data-exchange standard): mandatory electronic exchange plus the TUSS terminology table
e.title_hk: TISS（巴西補充醫療數據交換標準）：強制性電子交換 + TUSS 術語表
e.summary: 巴西补充医疗（私人健康计划）强制性电子数据交换标准：统一行政与临床数据、对接电子健康记录、经 Open Concept Lab 发布 TUSS 术语代码，另有数据质量监测程序
e.summary_en: Brazil’s mandatory electronic data-exchange standard for supplementary health (private health plans): it unifies administrative and clinical data, feeds the Electronic Health Record, publishes TUSS terminology codes through the Open Concept Lab, and has a companion data-quality monitoring programme
e.summary_hk: 巴西補充醫療（私人健康計劃）強制性電子數據交換標準：統一行政與臨床數據、對接電子健康記錄、經 Open Concept Lab 發布 TUSS 術語代碼，另有數據質量監測程序
e.body:
**TISS（Troca de Informações na Saúde Suplementar，补充医疗信息交换标准）** 是**巴西的强制性电子数据交换标准**，由 **ANS（Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar，巴西补充医疗监管局）** 制定。所谓「补充医疗（saúde suplementar）」指**私人健康计划与健康保险**——与公立 SUS 体系并行。本条目补的是**「强制性国家级理赔/就诊数据标准」这一形态**：实测池内 **TISS / HL7 / claims standard 等相关条目为 0**（池内健康险侧此前是**美国** CMS／Medicare 系、**瑞士** [[axa-ch-health-insurance-data]]、**韩国** [[ohdsi-korean-nsc-etl]]、**香港** [[vhis-standard-premium]]、**印度** [[indian-health-claims-skill]]、**中国** 侧若干，**拉美整片为 0**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**，页面体量实测）：⭐ **TISS 标准主页 177.2KB，标题实测「TISS - Padrão para Troca de Informação de Saúde Suplementar」**，正文实测写明它「**foi estabelecida como um padrão obrigatório para as trocas eletrônicas de dados de atenção à saúde dos beneficiários de planos**」（**被确立为计划受益人健康照护数据电子交换的强制性标准**），目标为「**padronizar as ações administrativas, subsidiar as ações de avaliação e acompanhamento econômico, financeiro e assistencial das operadoras**」并**组成 Registro Eletrônico de Saúde（电子健康记录）**，其指导原则是在 ANS 与卫生部系统之间实现**互操作性**并**降低受益人的信息不对称**；页面实测列出 **「Padrão TISS – Julho/2026」（2026 年 7 月版）**、**「Histórico das versões dos Componentes」（各组件版本历史）**、**「Tabelas Relacionadas」（相关表）** 与 **TUSS 代码**入口；**页面更新日期实测 30/07/2026 11h44**。⭐ **TUSS 代码页 176.5KB，标题实测「Códigos da TUSS」**，正文实测写明 **TUSS（Terminologia Unificada da Saúde Suplementar，补充医疗统一术语）** 的代码可在**一个为组织、管理与标准化健康术语而开发的开源工具**中访问，且「**a plataforma é baseada no Open Concept Lab (OCL)**」，TUSS **集成于 TISS 标准之内**，被**健康计划运营商、服务提供方与系统开发者**使用；**页面更新日期实测 15/07/2026 17h54**。配套数据：**ANS「Dados e Indicadores do Setor」232.3KB** 与 **ANS「Dados Abertos」187.6KB**（后者实测含 **PDA 2026-2028** 数据开放计划文件，**更新日期实测 04/09/2026 13h07**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「标准层」这一形态，而且是强制性的**——池内健康险数据侧此前**全是数据本身或工具**（CMS 开放数据、HCC 风险调整、[[omop-common-data-model]] 等），**「这些数据以什么标准被强制交换」这一层此前没有**；TISS 是**政府强制、覆盖全行业**的口径，与池内 [[badx12]]（美国 X12 837/835 理赔报文的编辑规则）形成**两地对照**——**同是理赔报文层，美国以行业标准 X12 为载体，巴西以监管强制标准 TISS 为载体**（可与 [[healthcare-mrf-api]] 的美国价格透明口径、[[uwmd]] 的承保互操作标准并读）。**② TUSS 用 Open Concept Lab 发布代码，是一个具体可借鉴的做法**——**国家级医疗术语表没有做成静态 PDF，而是放到开源术语平台上**，这对做**条款/术语标准化**方向的学生是一个现成案例；可与 [[vhis-standard-premium]]（香港自愿医保按标准计划与保费）、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]、[[lossratio-r]] 并读。**③ 它解释了「为什么巴西的健康险数据可分析」**——强制标准 + 电子健康记录目标 + 数据开放计划三者叠加，**是拉美唯一具备这一数据底座的健康险市场**（可与 [[cmf-chile]] 的智利监管统计、[[ans-tiss-standard]] 同轮其他条目并读）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、关键正文表述（强制性、电子健康记录目标、TUSS 与 OCL 的关系、版本号与更新日期）与页面体量**，**但未下载任何 TISS 组件文件、未打开任何 XML/JSON 规范、未打开 TUSS 代码表**，因此**不能转述 TISS 的具体字段、报文结构与版本差异**；**② TUSS 代码表本次未实际检索**——**只是核实到「载体是 Open Concept Lab」这一事实**；**③ ANS 开放数据页所列数据集的清单与下载可用性本次未逐项核实**（**未下载任何数据集**）；**④ 页面以葡萄牙语为主，英文覆盖度未核实**；**⑤** 本词条**不主张** TISS 或 ANS 提供精算工具或模型。**核实说明**：TISS 主页（177.2KB）、Códigos da TUSS（176.5KB）、Dados e Indicadores do Setor（232.3KB）、Dados Abertos（187.6KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与正文表述；**未下载组件文件、未打开规范或代码表**。
e.body_en:
**TISS (Troca de Informações na Saúde Suplementar)** is **Brazil’s mandatory electronic data-exchange standard**, set by **ANS (Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar)**, the supplementary-health regulator. "Supplementary health" means **private health plans and health insurance**, running in parallel with the public SUS system. This entry adds the **"mandatory national claims and encounter data standard"** form: a measured search found **zero entries for TISS, HL7 or any "claims standard"** (the corpus’s health-insurance side previously held **US** CMS/Medicare items, **Swiss** [[axa-ch-health-insurance-data]], **Korean** [[ohdsi-korean-nsc-etl]], **Hong Kong** [[vhis-standard-premium]], **Indian** [[indian-health-claims-skill]] and several **Chinese** items — **with Latin America entirely absent**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**, with page sizes measured): ⭐ the **TISS homepage is 177.2KB with the measured title "TISS - Padrão para Troca de Informação de Saúde Suplementar"**, and its body states verbatim that it **"foi estabelecida como um padrão obrigatório para as trocas eletrônicas de dados de atenção à saúde dos beneficiários de planos"** (it **was established as a mandatory standard for the electronic exchange of health-care data for plan beneficiaries**), aims to **"padronizar as ações administrativas, subsidiar as ações de avaliação e acompanhamento econômico, financeiro e assistencial das operadoras"** and to form the **Registro Eletrônico de Saúde (Electronic Health Record)**, its guiding principle being **interoperability** between ANS and Ministry of Health systems and **reducing beneficiaries’ information asymmetry**; the page lists a measured **"Padrão TISS – Julho/2026"** (July 2026 version), a **"Histórico das versões dos Componentes"** (component version history), **"Tabelas Relacionadas"** and an entry to **TUSS** codes; the **measured last-updated date is 30/07/2026 11h44**. ⭐ The **TUSS codes page is 176.5KB with the measured title "Códigos da TUSS"**, stating verbatim that **TUSS (Terminologia Unificada da Saúde Suplementar)** codes can be accessed in **an open-source tool built to organise, manage and standardise health terminologies** and that **"a plataforma é baseada no Open Concept Lab (OCL)"**; TUSS **is a component of the TISS standard** and is used by **health-plan operators, service providers and system developers**; the **measured last-updated date is 15/07/2026 17h54**. Companion data: ANS **"Dados e Indicadores do Setor" (232.3KB)** and ANS **"Dados Abertos" (187.6KB)**, the latter with measured **PDA 2026-2028** open-data plan files and a **measured last-updated date of 04/09/2026 13h07**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "standards layer", and a mandatory one** — the corpus’s health-insurance side previously held **only data or tools** (CMS open data, HCC risk adjustment, [[omop-common-data-model]] and so on), and **"the standard by which that data must be exchanged" had no entry**; TISS is a **government-mandated, industry-wide** regime, contrasting with [[badx12]] (US edit rules for X12 837/835 claim messages) — **the same claim-message layer, carried in the US by an industry standard (X12) and in Brazil by a regulator-mandated standard (TISS)** (readable with [[healthcare-mrf-api]] on US price transparency and [[uwmd]] on underwriting interoperability). **② TUSS publishing its codes through the Open Concept Lab is a concrete, transferable practice** — a **national health-terminology table delivered on an open terminology platform rather than as a static PDF**, a ready case for students working on **clause and terminology standardisation** (read with [[vhis-standard-premium]] on Hong Kong’s VHIS standard plans and premiums, [[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]] and [[lossratio-r]]). **③ It explains why Brazilian health-insurance data is analysable** — a mandatory standard plus an Electronic Health Record goal plus an open-data plan together make Brazil **the only Latin American health-insurance market with this data foundation** (read with [[cmf-chile]] and the other entries added this round).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, key body statements (mandatoriness, the Electronic Health Record goal, the TUSS-OCL relationship, version labels and update dates) and page sizes**, **but downloaded no TISS component file, opened no XML or JSON specification and opened no TUSS code table**, so **TISS field definitions, message structures and version differences cannot be restated**; **② the TUSS code table was not actually searched** — **only the fact that its carrier is the Open Concept Lab was verified**; **③ the dataset list on the ANS open-data page and its download availability were not verified item by item** (**no dataset was downloaded**); **④ the pages are mainly in Portuguese and English coverage was not verified**; **⑤** this entry **does not claim TISS or ANS provides actuarial tools or models**. **Verification note**: the TISS homepage (177.2KB), Códigos da TUSS (176.5KB), Dados e Indicadores do Setor (232.3KB) and Dados Abertos (187.6KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and body statements read; **no component file, specification or code table was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**TISS（Troca de Informações na Saúde Suplementar，補充醫療信息交換標準）** 是**巴西的強制性電子數據交換標準**，由 **ANS（Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar，巴西補充醫療監管局）** 制定。「補充醫療」指**私人健康計劃與健康保險**，與公立 SUS 並行。本條目補的是**「強制性國家級理賠／就診數據標準」這一形態**：實測池內 **TISS / HL7 / claims standard 相關條目為 0**（池內健康險側此前是**美國** CMS／Medicare 系、**瑞士** [[axa-ch-health-insurance-data]]、**韓國** [[ohdsi-korean-nsc-etl]]、**香港** [[vhis-standard-premium]]、**印度** [[indian-health-claims-skill]] 等，**拉美整片為 0**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **TISS 主頁 177.2KB，標題實測「TISS - Padrão para Troca de Informação de Saúde Suplementar」**，正文寫明它「**foi estabelecida como um padrão obrigatório**」（**被確立為強制性標準**），目標為統一營運商的行政與經濟／財務／照護評估口徑並**組成電子健康記錄（Registro Eletrônico de Saúde）**，指導原則是在 ANS 與衛生部系統之間實現**互操作性**、**降低資訊不對稱**；頁面列出 **「Padrão TISS – Julho/2026」**、**組件版本歷史**與 **TUSS 代碼**入口；**更新日期實測 30/07/2026 11h44**。⭐ **TUSS 代碼頁 176.5KB，標題實測「Códigos da TUSS」**，正文寫明 **TUSS（補充醫療統一術語）** 代碼可在**一個為組織、管理與標準化健康術語而開發的開源工具**中訪問，且「**a plataforma é baseada no Open Concept Lab (OCL)**」，TUSS **集成於 TISS 之內**，被**健康計劃運營商、服務提供方與系統開發者**使用；**更新日期實測 15/07/2026 17h54**。配套：**ANS「Dados e Indicadores do Setor」232.3KB**、**ANS「Dados Abertos」187.6KB**（含 **PDA 2026-2028**，**更新日期實測 04/09/2026 13h07**）。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「標準層」，而且是強制性的**——池內健康險數據側此前**全是數據本身或工具**，**「這些數據以什麼標準被強制交換」此前沒有**；與 [[badx12]]（美國 X12 837/835 理賠報文編輯規則）形成**兩地對照**——**同是理賠報文層，美國以行業標準為載體，巴西以監管強制標準為載體**（可與 [[healthcare-mrf-api]]、[[uwmd]] 並讀）。**② TUSS 用 Open Concept Lab 發布代碼是具體可借鑑的做法**——**國家級醫療術語表沒有做成靜態 PDF，而是放到開源術語平台**（可與 [[vhis-standard-premium]]、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]、[[lossratio-r]] 並讀）。**③ 它解釋了「為何巴西的健康險數據可分析」**——強制標準 + 電子健康記錄目標 + 數據開放計劃三者疊加，**是拉美唯一具備此數據底座的健康險市場**（可與 [[cmf-chile]] 並讀）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、關鍵正文表述、版本號與更新日期**，**但未下載任何 TISS 組件檔案、未打開任何 XML/JSON 規範、未打開 TUSS 代碼表**，故**不能轉述 TISS 的具體欄位、報文結構與版本差異**；**② TUSS 代碼表本次未實際檢索**——**只核實到「載體是 Open Concept Lab」**；**③ ANS 開放數據集清單與下載可用性未逐項核實**（**未下載任何數據集**）；**④ 頁面以葡萄牙語為主，英文覆蓋度未核實**；**⑤** 本詞條**不主張** TISS 或 ANS 提供精算工具或模型**。**核實說明**：四頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載組件檔案、未打開規範或代碼表**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（TISS 主页 177.2KB 标题「TISS - Padrão para Troca de Informação de Saúde Suplementar」，正文含「padrão obrigatório」「Registro Eletrônico de Saúde」「interoperabilidade」，更新日期 30/07/2026 11h44，含「Padrão TISS – Julho/2026」；Códigos da TUSS 176.5KB 标题「Códigos da TUSS」，正文含「plataforma é baseada no Open Concept Lab (OCL)」，更新日期 15/07/2026 17h54；Dados e Indicadores do Setor 232.3KB；Dados Abertos 187.6KB 含 PDA 2026-2028，更新日期 04/09/2026 13h07）+ ★池内 TISS/HL7/claims standard 条目 0、拉美健康险 0；未下载组件文件、未打开 XML/JSON 规范或 TUSS 代码表、未下载任何数据集
